methodology.normalization: 100 × (evidence step timestamp − first step timestamp) / (last step timestamp − first step timestamp)
methodology.timingScope: Recorded session-step time; not exact metric computation completion time or a common fixed wall-clock interval.
methodology.estimator: Within-run cumulative maximum over confirmed validation observations, then median across runs with an observation at that time; known best is carried forward after its first observation.
methodology.missing: No backfill before a run's first observation; null means no confirmed observation was available.
methodology.sampling: Exact original observation times and source summary knots; no smoothing, quantization, or resampling.
methodology.runPoints: Within-run cumulative maximum at every original confirmed observation time. Repeated elapsed times and repeated best scores are retained.
methodology.scoreScope: Validation feedback includes confirmed single-model and ensemble observations, including source-flagged full-validation OOF/CV feedback.
methodology.baseline: Dashed references are validation scores. The original six-panel appendix used test references; curve values are unchanged.
methodology.coverage: Six recommendation tasks and the three agent configurations shown in the source figure; 53 included runs and 17,647 confirmed observations.

excluded.reason: Excluded in the audited source figure; this configuration has two included runs.
Source audit excludes explicit smoke/timing/subset probes, diagnostic oracle or in-sample scores, and synthetic pipeline tests; no score-magnitude cutoff is applied.
